scope: Finite source-only review of exact S66 camera / score / recompute adapter for actual S64 saved outputs. No formal mode or scientific body execution.

V12 camera selection/store/decoder/math consists of 23 unchanged function/class definitions and 5 original constants extracted directly from same SHA-verified source bytes. file_snapshot wrapper changes logging/deadline binding only; no numeric function AST changed.

No condition-output coordinate matrices substitute for original requested cameras.

Exactly final cache_commit occurrence 1 exports the ordered nine pil_frames pixel descriptors. Camera mode reads their metadata only; score/recompute read immutable uint8[576,576,3] snapshots, descriptor-plus-body hashes, nine logical payloads totaling 8957952 bytes. Original primary and independent kernel full bytes are loaded under non-main module names. Score preserves M_outer4, ID0/8, float64/255, strict MSE>0.01, copy guard, all four regions, full-frame and three generated-pair diagnostics. Independent compare_math checks all records, floathex, PSNR, counts and event exactly.

Legacy C1 row/status/cohort labels are removed from emitted camera and math fields; the comparator row_status compatibility string is internal only. Reports retain S64 row, actual retrieval_variant and ineligible-for-original-cohort/new-method-false boundaries.
Eight actual metadata pins bind S64 manifest/external/commit, completed postrun report/receipt/independent result review and archive/events. No future camera/score SHA is prefilled.

Three explicit modes do not auto-chain: score requires actual different-author camera result review with observed return0, exact source/report/receipt/nine-ID bindings; recompute requires exact sealed primary report/receipt and the same authoritative pixel table.

Each formal mode claims its own fresh create-only directory, preserves failure receipts and partial payload-attempt scope, checks 110-second inner deadline and emits nonzero on failures or recompute mismatch. Root owns actual external return and post-return 0444 sealing.

Camera initial-body reads and successful close verification bytes are separate. A failed close is explicitly unknown, not zero. RGB payload_attempts can record partial reads; prior S64 postrun RGB access is acknowledged rather than claiming restored blindness.

independent_check.kind: single source compile-only under existing Python; no synthetic case repeated

execution_boundaries: Root externally supervises each actual mode and seals outputs 0444 after true return before downstream consumption; source review is not a return receipt.
Camera failure remains invalid/no-valid-revisit evidence, not RGB return harm.
Independent camera result review precedes score. Actual sealed score precedes recompute; independent result review precedes viewing all nine frames.
No camera success, pixel identity success, numeric scores or quality/causality/method/novelty outcomes are approved here.
